meta.name: alfworld-inventory-management
meta.description: Use when the agent must collect and track multiple instances of the same object type in ALFWorld (e.g., "put two cellphone in bed"). This skill maintains a count of collected versus needed objects, guides systematic searching through receptacles, and ensures each found object is placed at the target before searching for the next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在ALFWorld中自动收集并追踪多个同类物品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在ALFWorld中按数量要求收集并放置多个同类物品。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically collect and track multiple instances of the same object in ALFWorld
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect and place multiple instances of the same object type in ALFWorld.

howto.what: 在 ALFWorld 游戏中，当需要收集多个同种物品时，Claude 会记录已收集和所需数量，按可见表面、封闭容器等顺序依次搜索，每找到一件立即放到目标位置，再找下一件。
howto.when: 当任务要求收集多个同种物品（如“把两个手机放到床上”）时触发。

say.note: Claude 会计数并按流程搜索。

say.text: 我需要收集三个书放到书架上。
say.note: Claude 会依次找三个书并放好。

say.text: 先找桌子，再找抽屉，找到的笔放到笔筒里，要两支。
say.note: Claude 会按优先级搜索并计数。

howto.what_en: When collecting multiple instances of the same object type in ALFWorld, Claude tracks collected vs needed count, systematically searches receptacles (visible surfaces first, then closed containers, etc.), and places each found object at the target before searching for the next.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task requires collecting multiple instances of the same object type (e.g., "put two cellphone in bed").

say_en.text: Put two cellphones in the bed.
say_en.note: Claude will count and follow the search flow.

say_en.text: I need to collect three books and put them on the bookshelf.
say_en.note: Claude will find each book and place it.

say_en.text: Search desks first, then drawers; find a pen and put it in the pen holder, I need two.
